_note: reports-compare-periods-and-scheduled-delivery. An export destination of type mail sends the formatted report as an attachment to Nextcloud users and groups (ReportMailDelivery); it needs no connector source or path, so those are required by ExportDestinationService for the other types only. Version 1.1.0 adds the type and the optional recipients.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: The Nextcloud users and groups a mailed report goes to.
